articles.title: Ukraine war briefing: Kyiv blasts peace talks as just ‘smokescreen’ for Trump‘s Russian diesel deal
articles.summary:
Trump’s announcement a betrayal of Ukraine, Democrats say; Ukraine strikes major datacentre in Russia. What we know on day 1,690

Ukrainian peace negotiators in Miami have been used as a “smokescreen” for a “weak” decision by Donald Trump to lift diesel sanctions on Russia, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in a furious response to the US president’s backflip on Russian sanctions. In a move likely to create a fresh crisis with Washington’s Nato allies, Trump announced the deal with Putin on his Truth Social network, saying it was essential to reduce fuel prices in the US, which have soared as a result of his decision to go to war with Iran. The Ukrainian president, who flew to Washington last month to plead with US lawmakers to pass tougher sanctions on Russia, said in a statement on Friday that it was “unfortunately, a weak decision by strong partners”. “I believe our team is simply being used as a smokescreen. And that is certainly not fair. It is certainly not how partners should treat each other.”

Negotiators for the ⁠US, Ukraine and Europe ⁠held ​six ‌hours ‌of talks ‌in Miami on Friday with the aim ‌of reaching agreement ​on ending ​the war ​in ​Ukraine, ​a ‌source ​briefed ​on the talks said. They discussed a postwar economic package for Ukraine and potential new security architecture between Europe and Russia, the source said. President Trump announced the diesel deal as his envoy Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner were meeting with Ukrainian officials in Florida to discuss a peace plan.

Trump’s announcement was a betrayal of Ukraine, the European allies and US national security, said Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer, top Democrat on the Foreign Relations Committee Sen. Jeanne Shaheen, and senior Democrat senator, Elizabeth Warren. “Enough is enough,” the senators wrote. “The President must end his war with Iran instead of funding Russia’s war machine.”

A number of prominent Republicans joined Democrats on Friday to condemn Trump for lifting the diesel sanctions, including congressman Don Bacon, who said the majority of Americans supported Ukraine. “The President’s policies towards Russia and Ukraine are failures. We need moral clarity not moral ambiguity.”

Ukraine struck and partly disabled a major datacentre operated by Russian technology company Yandex on Friday in the second such action in successive days. Yandex, which is heavily involved in Russia’s ​AI development, said its data centre in the Kaluga region south-west of Moscow had been struck by Ukrainian drones and partly put out of action. Ukrainian arms maker Firepoint said Kyiv had used its FP-1 one-way attack drones to mount the ⁠strike.

Four Ukrainians were arrested in Vienna this week on ⁠suspicion of spying, Austrian interior minister, Gerhard Karner, said on Friday, with Ukrainska ⁠Pravda newspaper saying two ⁠of ​its team were among those detained. Three remain in custody, Karner said, declining ⁠to provide further details because the investigation was ongoing. Austrian news agency APA quoted a ⁠spokeswoman for the Ukrainian embassy in Vienna as saying ​it was awaiting ‌an explanation from the ‌Austrian authorities on the circumstances of and legal grounds ‌for the arrests. The embassy did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Russian ⁠forces struck ​three cargo vessels in and ⁠around Ukraine’s Black Sea ports on ⁠Friday, Russia’s defence ministry ​said. The ‌ministry said ‌one vessel was ‌hit in the port of Mykolaiv, another in the port of Chornomorsk and ‌a third, bound for Odesa, in the ​Black Sea. According to the ministry, all three vessels ⁠were being used ​to supply ​the Ukrainian ​military. Reuters could ​not ‌independently verify ​the ​report or the claim.

Russian strikes killed three people and wounded at least eight across Ukraine, officials said Friday, as Ukraine struggles to counter escalating Russian bombardments that have killed more than 50 people over the past three days.

archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing escalating security risks due to ongoing brutal Russian strikes on Ukrainian civilian and energy infrastructure. Within the EU, tensions are mounting driven by violent student protests in France, growing pressure from Chinese competition on the automotive sector, and fears of looming hybrid attacks.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající napětí na trzích v reakci na eskalaci geopolitických střetů, bezpečnostní incidenty a pokračující protivládní nepokoje ve Francii.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, persistent market tension is expected in response to escalating geopolitical clashes, security incidents, and ongoing anti-government unrest in France.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí kombinaci eskalujícího geopolitického napětí, pokračující války na Ukrajině a vnitřních politicko-sociálních krizí od Francie přes Polsko po Itálii. Ekonomické trhy nervózně sledují rostoucí výnosy dluhopisů, fiskální tlaky v klíčových zemích a napjaté obchodní vztahy s Čínou.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a combination of escalating geopolitical tensions, the ongoing war in Ukraine, and internal political and social crises ranging from France and Poland to Italy. Economic markets are nervously monitoring rising bond yields, fiscal pressures in key countries, and tense trade relations with China.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající volatilitu na trzích v důsledku geopolitického napětí a nejistoty kolem fiskální stability vybraných členských států.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, persistent market volatility is expected due to geopolitical tensions and uncertainty surrounding the fiscal stability of selected member states.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí kombinaci eskalujícího geopolitického napětí, včetně intenzivních bojů na Ukrajině a diplomatických roztržek, a rostoucímu domácímu neklidu. Protesty ve Francii a sociální krize ve Španělsku zatěžují politickou stabilitu, zatímco energetická zranitelnost před zimou a fiskální tlaky zvyšují makroekonomická rizika.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is grappling with escalating geopolitical tensions, including intense warfare in Ukraine and diplomatic spats, alongside mounting domestic unrest. Protests in France and social crises in Spain are straining political stability, while winter energy vulnerabilities and fiscal pressures heighten macroeconomic risks.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu na trzích v důsledku geopolitického napětí na východní hranici EU a přetrvávajících sociálních nepokojů v západní Evropě.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued market volatility is expected due to geopolitical tensions on the EU's eastern border and persistent social unrest in Western Europe.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí kombinaci vnitřního sociálního napětí, včetně násilných studentských protestů ve Francii, a přetrvávajících geopolitických rizik spojených s válkou na Ukrajině a bezpečnostními incidenty v regionu. Na ekonomické frontě EU usiluje o posílení konkurenceschopnosti reformou finančních trhů a řeší obchodní otázky ohledně čínských elektromobilů.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a combination of internal social tensions, including violent student protests in France, and persistent geopolitical risks linked to the war in Ukraine and regional security incidents. On the economic front, the EU is striving to boost competitiveness through financial market reforms while addressing trade issues regarding Chinese electric vehicles.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající volatilitu na trzích v důsledku geopolitického napětí a probíhajících politických změn v členských státech EU.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued market volatility is expected due to ongoing geopolitical tensions and ongoing political adjustments across EU member states.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí vlně sociálních nepokojů a protestů proti úsporným opatřením a vládním výdajům (zejména ve Francii a Belgii), zatímco geopolitické napětí eskaluje kvůli dohodám USA o ruské ropě a pokračujícím útokům na Ukrajině. Evropská centrální banka nadále upravuje své měnové směrnice v prostředí přetrvávající ekonomické nestability a globálních obchodních třenic.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a wave of social unrest and protests against austerity measures and government spending (particularly in France and Belgium), while geopolitical tensions escalate due to US deals on Russian oil and ongoing attacks in Ukraine.
